I will use a different approach to simulate user input, such as using a mock input stream. I will update the test and run it again.", "final_test": "import pytest
from click import prompt
from unittest.mock import patch
from io import StringIO

def test_prompt_backspace_behavior():
    # Test that backspace works correctly in the prompt
    with patch('sys.stdin', StringIO('\x7f\x7f\x7f')):  # Simulate three backspaces
        with patch('sys.stdout', new=StringIO()) as fake_out:
            result = prompt('Enter something')
            assert result == ''  # Expect the input to be empty after three backspaces


if __name__ == '__main__':
    pytest.main([__file__])"}
